Uses of Package
network.ike.knowledge.spi

  • Classes in network.ike.knowledge.spi used by network.ike.knowledge.spi
    Class
    Description
    ArtifactInput
    One knowledge artifact in an ordered input list — list position is load order, the fit contract: the base comes first so every identity later inputs reference is present, and each change set then merges by public id.
    ArtifactInput.Role
    The kinds of assembly input.
    AssembleRequest
    A knowledge-base assembly request: ordered inputs into a store at a root, classified by default under the given view (IKE-Network/ike-issues#848, #850).
    AssembleResult
    What an assembly produced: per-input load summaries, the classification summary when classification ran, and the effective-view report the implementation wrote beside the store (every dimension fully resolved — the reproducibility record).
    BindingsRequest
    A bindings-generation request: emit a compiler-visible constants class for a knowledge set's declarations (IKE-Network/ike-issues#824) or for a loaded store's concepts and patterns.
    BindingsRequest.Mode
    Where bindings declarations come from.
    BindingsResult
    What a bindings generation produced.
    ClassificationSummary
    What a classification run over an assembled store produced.
    ConceptRef
    A concept reference as written in a POM or ViewSpec — the three forms of the IKE-KNOWLEDGE-VIEW reference grammar (IKE-Network/ike-issues#849, #851): uuid:<uuid>[,<uuid>...] — exact identity; a list, because public ids are UUID sets (ConceptRef.Uuids); <BindingsClass>#<CONSTANT> or bare #<CONSTANT> — a bindings-class constant, resolved by reflective static-field read on the implementation side; with no class named, the implementation's default bindings class applies (override per spec via ViewSpec.REFS_DEFAULT_BINDING_CLASS) (ConceptRef.Binding); text:<name> or any other bare string — a description text, resolved as a unique live fully qualified or regular name against the store; ambiguity or no-match fails the build (ConceptRef.Text).
    EntityCounts
    Entity counts by kind — the shared shape of load summaries and export results.
    ExportRequest
    A knowledge-set export request: compose the ledger source, replay it, and export the change-set artifact — optionally extracting the koncept definitions (glossary source) from the same materialized store.
    ExportResult
    What a knowledge-set export produced.
    Finding
    One verification finding.
    Finding.Severity
    Finding severities.
    KnowledgeService
    Base contract of every knowledge-pipeline service: a typed execution method plus the properties-codec bridge that lets IkeServiceBootstrap drive any service generically across the forked-JVM seam.
    LoadSummary
    What one input artifact contributed to an assembly.
    VerifyReport
    A verification's findings.
    VerifyRequest
    A knowledge-set verification request (IKE-Network/ike-issues#852): checks run against a pristine store assembled from the declared base plus the artifact under verification — never against the store that produced it.
    VerifyRequest.Check
    The verification checks.
    ViewSpec
    The view specification — dotted dimension keys mirroring the coordinate constituents (stamp, language, logic, navigation, edit), stating only what differs from the implementation's defaults (IKE-Network/ike-issues#849; normative schema: IKE-KNOWLEDGE-VIEW, IKE-Network/ike-issues#851).
